scope: Offline diagnosis on original teacher train/validation and trained-student development smoke; no test-by-game selection
diagnostic_candidate_selection: At most one teacher-label crop stratum: rank mean per-training-seed teacher-score-gap sum per eligible decision; eligible outcomes request_seed or plant_request; require at least three eligible disagreements in each of at least two training seeds; tie fixed crop order. Score gap is teacher preference, not official return. Validation and student smoke only diagnostic corroboration. Do not alter rule after reading new games.
stop: No training, feature changes, new candidates or more than36 games in this phase; freeze exact probe, new seeds and source identity before any new game; no claim of significance from two seeds
